_about: v3#104: the built seam pass (scripts/lib/seam-pass.mjs seamStage, agy gemini-3.8-flash-low, edit-before on) over the STORED English of French and Italian 2-4 page blocks served by the agy @4 route, seed 104 (72 French blocks / 44 books, 27 Italian / 7 books). #7118 Opus seam judge, blind, both orders, every join (396 calls, all parsed); route-judge-6740 Opus page judge, image open, on every page the pass changed (60 items with controls). S = broken joins at a block start per 100, T = inside a block, lane = 0.75 T + 0.25 S. Rule pre-registered on v3#104 (the v2#8399 clauses, per language). Write-up: scripts/eval/experiments/2026-11-13-seam-pass-fr-it-104.md; verdicts: scripts/eval/results/seam-fr-it-104/report.json and scripts/eval/route-judge-6740/results/seam-fr-it-104/.
